newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Consgold has gold deposit option.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Consgold has gold deposit option.

text.p: Western Australia miner Consolidated Gold NL said on Monday it has entered into an option agreement with Dalrymple Resources NL to purchase the Ulysess mine project.
Ulysess has existing inferred resources of 78,000 ounces of gold, Consolidated Gold said.
Under the terms of the agreement, Consoliodated Gold said it will pay Dalrymple A$25,000 and spend A$75,000 on exploration drilling.
Subject to the results of the exploration and granting of a mining lease, Consolidated Gold said it can exercise the option by paying Dalrymple A$550,000, plus a royalty fee.
Consolidated gold said the prospect had the potential to substantially add to the resource base at its Kookynie deposit, which produced 19,060 ounces of gold in the last quarter.
